name: M12 gallery
author: benhenn

sections.description:
M12 Gallery 🔧 is a WordPress plugin 🧩 for visual step-by-step guides using a custom Gutenberg block. Just search ‘m12-gallery’ to add it!

Live Demo:
See it in action here

These guides are excellent for clearly and comprehensibly illustrating work processes.
What makes it special: The guide works like a flipbook. When you hover over it with your mouse, you can see exactly what changes – for example, plug in, unplug, plug in, unplug…
sections.installation:
1. Upload the m12-gallery folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. In the Gutenberg editor, add a new block by searching for “M12 Gallery”.
  4. Select images and publish to view the gallery on the frontend.
sections.faq:
How can I disable the credit label?

In the block inspector (sidebar), you’ll find a “Disable ‘made with’” option that suppresses the label. Please ask before you do that: post@benjaminhenn.de
sections.changelog:
1.0

  • Initial release with gallery block, thumbnails, credit label, and Swiper.js integration.
